cases.title: Realtime brain scanner

cases.title: Jev practice speed harness
cases.one_line: A public practice project lets developers obtain a Jev API key and test their own decision speed against Jev, turning the API into a repeatable latency practice harness.

cases.title: NotHotDog multimodal decision app
cases.one_line: The open-source nothotdog demo uses a vision model to write one sentence about an image and Jev to decide from that description; the author reports 1002 ms end-to-end versus 327 ms for the Jev half and displays both bars.

cases.title: Verdict OSS-Jev benchmark update

cases.title: Curated Jev application catalog

cases.one_line: The post describes Laya as an open-source 421M non-autoregressive System One model with one-forward-pass probability decisions, no text generation, and local GPU execution, claiming faster and better-calibrated results than Jev.
